theorems.name: Submission.f036cc6b1f_pc_hecke_integral
theorems.statement: ∀ (M : ℕ) [NeZero M] (F : Set UpperHalfPlane), MeasurableSet F → (∀ᵐ z ∂(MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure UpperHalfPlane), ∃ γ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ, γ ∈ (CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma0 M) ∧ γ • z ∈ F ∧ ∀ δ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ, δ ∈ (CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma0 M) → δ • z ∈ F → δ = γ ∨ δ = -γ) → ∀ (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hpM : ¬ p ∣ M) (f g : CuspForm (CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma0 M) 2), MeasureTheory.integral ((MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure UpperHalfPlane).restrict F) (UpperHalfPlane.petersson 2 (CuspForm.heckeTLin 2 hp hpM f) g) = MeasureTheory.integral ((MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure UpperHalfPlane).restrict F) (UpperHalfPlane.petersson 2 f (CuspForm.heckeTLin 2 hp hpM g))
theorems.natural_summary: Uses accepted slash-transfer, transversal, domain-lift, trace-unfolding, and Petersson-core results to exchange and refold the two integrals.
